subject: Incident follow-up: evidence curation & cross-region handover
messages:
From: Acme Sec Team <security@acme.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 18 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-incident evidence hold and transfer request

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for rapid support during yesterday's availability incident. Our security team is preparing a short forensic review and we need to confirm Redwood's plan for post-incident log retention and secure evidence transfer. Specifically: 

- Please confirm which logs and artifacts you are placing on legal/forensic hold (API request logs, edge access logs, KV-cache evictions, instance console logs).
- Confirm retention windows for those artifacts (we need them preserved for 90 days by default) and whether any automated deletion jobs are paused.
- Provide the S3 paths (or equivalent) where artifacts will be stored and whether data will cross regions for handoff. Our compliance requirement is that initial capture stay in us-west-2 and any cross-region transfer must be logged.
- We will need a chain-of-custody manifest and an exported manifest (CSV) listing file names, hashes, and timestamps. Can you provide a signed manifest and the mechanism for transfer (SFTP/secure Drive link)?

We're also planning to bring in an external auditor (cc'd in a subsequent message) to collect a copy. Ideally we'd like an answer by end of day so we can scope their work.

Thanks,
--
Ana Delgado
Security Ops Lead, Acme Corporation
security@acme.com
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: Acme Sec Team <security@acme.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 18 Nov 2027 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Post-incident evidence hold and transfer request

Ana — thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front, details below.

Summary (we will):
- Place the following artifacts on hold immediately: API request logs (prod), edge access logs, host console capture for impacted nodes, KV-cache eviction snapshots for the affected model groups.
- Pause any automated deletion/rollup jobs for those artifact namespaces for 120 days (we can shorten to 90 if you require).
- Store initial captures in s3://redwood-evidence/us-west-2/incidents/2027-11-17-ACME/ — cross-region transfer will be performed only with explicit request and will be recorded in transfer_audit.log.
- We will provide a chain-of-custody PDF and a CSV manifest with filename, MD5, SHA256, capture timestamp, and current S3 URI. Transfer options: secure Drive folder (shared link with restricted domain), or temporary SFTP; if you have a preference, confirm.

Details: 
On Thu, 18 Nov 2027 at 09:12 AM Acme Sec Team <security@acme.com> wrote:
> Hi Rishi,
>
> Thanks again for rapid support during yesterday's availability incident. Our security team is preparing a short forensic review and we need to confirm Redwood's plan for post-incident log retention and secure evidence transfer. Specifically: 
>
> - Please confirm which logs and artifacts you are placing on legal/forensic hold (API request logs, edge access logs, KV-cache evictions, instance console logs).

We will hold the following namespaces immediately: 
- prod/api-requests (retained as raw JSON, TTL paused)
- edge/requests (raw headers + timing)
- kvcache/snapshots/<model-group> (compressed gz)
- hosts/console-captures/<instance-id> (text)

Retention policy: automated deletion jobs will be paused; these artifacts will be held for 120 days by default. If Acme requires 90 days, we will update the hold policy to 90. After hold expires we will either delete or escalate retention per your written request.

Access controls & audit: only the following Redwood accounts will have read access to the evidence bucket: marissa_cole@redwood.com (evidence lead), soojin_lee@redwood.com (forensics), rishi_malhotra@redwood.com (incident owner). All object GETs will be logged and surfaced in transfer_audit.log.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Confirm transfer method (SFTP vs Drive).
2) Confirm whether you want initial copies to remain in us-west-2 or to be pushed to a specific Acme bucket.
3) If bringing an external auditor, please provide their contact and required timeframe; we will prepare the manifest and chain-of-custody PDF within 3 business hours.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Trust & Safety
Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Acme Sec Team <security@acme.com>, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 18 Nov 2027 13:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Evidence manifest and handoff package (attached)

Hi Ana / Rishi,

Per Rishi's note I've generated the initial evidence package and manifest. Files attached and summarized below. We have already applied object-level immutability tags for the affected prefixes.

Attachment: incident_evidence_manifest.csv (text/csv) — columns: filename, s3_uri, md5, sha256, capture_time, size_bytes
Attachment: kvcache-sample-20271118.log.gz (application/gzip) — sanitized sample (PII redaction verified)
Attachment: chain_of_custody.pdf (application/pdf) — signed by Marissa Cole (Digital signature)

Summary of storage and access:
- S3 path: s3://redwood-evidence/us-west-2/incidents/2027-11-17-ACME/
- Immutability: Object lock (governance mode) set for 120 days.
- Access list: marissa_cole@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com.
- Transfer log: transfer_audit.log contains the following upcoming entries once we initiate push (UUID: 4f7d3b0a): planned_transfer_time=2027-11-19T16:00:00-08:00, target=Acme-temp-bucket (us-west-2), mechanism=S3 copy w/server-side encryption, initiator=marissa_cole@redwood.com.

If you prefer SFTP or a Drive link instead of an S3 copy to an Acme bucket, tell us today and we will change the procedure. Otherwise we will proceed with secure S3 copy to your temporary bucket and share a short-lived presigned manifest and read-only link.

On Thu, 18 Nov 2027 at 10:05 AM rishi_malhotra@redwood.com wrote:
> Ana — thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front, details below.
>
> Summary (we will):

Please confirm which transfer method Acme prefers and provide the external auditor contact if you want them to fetch a copy directly.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Evidence Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: ThirdParty Audit <auditor@tp-audit.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: Acme Sec Team <security@acme.com>, soojin_lee@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 19 Nov 2027 15:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Evidence manifest and handoff package (attached)

Marissa / Rishi — auditor here (Sam Patel). Confirming receipt of the manifest and sample. We validated hashes for the top-level files and matched capture_time entries for the sample logs. A couple of quick asks before we fetch a full copy: 

- Please ensure the presigned S3 manifest link is valid for at least 72 hours.
- Include a short text file in the transfer with the transfer UUID and the signing identity (who executed the copy). We will attach that to our chain-of-custody ledger.
- We will fetch via temporary bucket in us-west-2; no cross-region transfer is required at this time.

If you can provide the presigned manifest and a copy of chain_of_custody.pdf (signed), we will schedule our collection tomorrow morning (11/20) at 08:00 PT.

On Thu, 18 Nov 2027 at 01:42 PM marissa_cole@redwood.com wrote:
> Per Rishi's note I've generated the initial evidence package and manifest. Files attached and summarized below. We have already applied object-level immutability tags for the affected prefixes.

Acknowledged — we'll proceed with S3 copy to the Acme-temp-bucket in us-west-2 and will add the transfer UUID and initiator.txt file to the root of the copy. Presigned manifest link will be sent to this thread within two hours.

Thanks,
Sam Patel
